title: Corless's nilpotent conjecture: proof, Lean formalisation and computations
description:
A proof of Conjecture 5.1 of R. M. Corless (Maple Transactions 1(2), 2021): the recursively constructed vectors give all nilpotent skew-symmetric tridiagonal matrices with superdiagonal entries in {1, i}, and there are exactly 2^(K-1) of them in dimension 2^K - 1. Modulo 4, a necessary condition for nilpotency is a linear system over F_2 that forces the outermost step of the recursion; an exact identity then reduces the problem to half the dimension.

The record contains the informal proof, a formalisation in Lean 4 with Mathlib in which the main theorems depend only on Lean's standard axioms, and Python and C scripts that check every step numerically and extend the exhaustive verification from m = 31 to m = 63.

The record accompanies the paper "Nilpotent skew-symmetric tridiagonal Bohemian matrices: a proof of Corless's conjecture" (M. Blattner, arXiv:2611.25266, 2026). Version 1.1.0 adds computations/check_extras.py, which checks by exact computation the results of the paper that are not formalised: the classification of the nilpotent tridiagonal sign matrices, the resolvent of a nilpotent matrix, and a doubling rule.

Version 1.1.1 cites the paper by its arXiv identifier, 2611.25266; the proof, the Lean formalisation and the computations are those of version 1.1.0.
